blurb: Guests experience tandem skydiving from 10,000 feet with about 30-40 seconds of freefall and a 3-5 minute parachute flight. They also offer an Accelerated Freefall (AFF) solo license program with jumps from 14,000 feet, providing about 9000 feet of freefall. The center operates from May to mid-October, weather permitting, at Westlock Municipal Airport north of Edmonton.
